description: Conduit fill for THHN/THWN-2 wires in EMT or Schedule 40 PVC: total wire area, percent fill against the NEC 53/31/40% limits, whether it fits, the smallest conduit that does, and the maximum number of same-size wires. Formula: Wire area = Σ count × Table 5 area (14 AWG 0.0097, 12 AWG 0.0133, 10 AWG 0.0211, 8 AWG 0.0366, 6 AWG 0.0507 sq in …). Allowed = Table 4 conduit area × 53% (1 wire), 31% (2) or 40% (3+). Same-size maximum = allowed ÷ wire area, rounded up only at 0.8 or more.
name: calc_conduit_fill
title: Conduit Fill Calculator (NEC Chapter 9, EMT and PVC)
